name: Audit Query API
description: Query the audit log: by principal, by time range, by capability, by decision outcome. Structured results, not raw logs.
purpose: Auditing is operational, not forensic archaeology.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit query API supports filtering by principal, time range, capability, and decision outcome.
Query results are structured (typed records, not raw log lines).
The API supports aggregation queries (count by outcome, by principal, by time window).
Audit queries respect the same authority policies as other operations.
